create_layerscale_module: create a LayerScale module with a given dimension and initialization value for gamma
build_layerscale_inplace: build a LayerScale module that performs in-place multiplication using the inplace flag
run_layerscale_forward: run the forward pass of LayerScale to scale input tensor by learnable gamma parameter
review_layerscale_init: review the LayerScale constructor to understand how gamma is initialized with init_values
test_layerscale_forward: test the LayerScale forward method with a tensor and verify gamma scaling behavior
